notes.title: Update: Improved Recoil and new Hit Marker Sounds
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dear Regain Earth Early Access Pioneers and Community Members!
New Regain Earth Update Now Available!

I'm excited to announce that a new update for Regain Earth: First Strike is now live on Steam! 
Sorry for the long time waiting for the update!
I want to express my gratitude to you all for your continued support and feedback, which helps me make the game even better. Here are the changes and improvements you can expect:

Updates & bug fixes

General: Hit markers now accompanied by satisfying hit sounds 
Weapon Balancing: Weapon recoil algorithm updated to reduce camera shake, providing a smoother shooting experience.
Weapon Balancing: Bolt weapons and rocket launchers now fire faster projectiles, making it easier to hit moving targets.
General: Bullet holes now visible from greater distances and quality settings affect their appearance, making the game world feel more dynamic.
Balancing: Grenade drop rates have been increased to provide more strategic options in combat. 

Join Our Community Discord
We have a small group of dedicated players and fans on our Discord server, where you can connect with like-minded individuals, share your thoughts and ideas, and even vote on new features. If you haven't already, you can also grab a demo or playtest key from our key-bot 24/7. Join us on Discord to get started!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. I can't wait to bring you even more exciting updates in the future. Stay tuned and stay healthy!

Until next time, happy gaming!
Sebastian (aka. TheFlow aka. GameDevDude)

notes.title: Update: Player Turrets! Homing Missile! Shield and Speed Grenade! New Mech Boss!
notes.notes:
Hello dear Regain Earth Players, Testers, Community & Early Access Pioneers,

Over the past few weeks I've released a lot of minor updates to Regain Earth: First Strike, and here I'd like to give an overview of all those changes.

Thank you!
As always and first of all, I want to say a big thank you to our awesome testers & Discord community & TikTok community for giving me feedback on REFS and great new ideas. This is what drives the development of the game!
Thanks a lot!!!

[previewyoutube=6QMhrhlEna8;full][/previewyoutube]

Updates!

 New player air defense turret with homing missiles, which also intercept rockets from opponents. Can be found as a grenade.
 New boss fight, a different kind of mech (Mech "Runner"). Faster and with different weapon, but no missiles.
 Now two grenade slots instead of one
 New shield grenades. Now a total of 3 shield grenade types and new visualization.
 Melee weapon (sci-fi baton) new design and with animation when equipping.
 Translations Germand and Polish
 New grenade that turns into a laser firing turret that supports the player. Unlimited in time, the turret remains at your side until it is destroyed. Turret, like the player, is recognized as an enemy by AI and attacked.
 Higher overall grenade drop rate
 Effects of frost and speed grenade extended
 Visual  HUD Weapon Slots and grenade Slots
 New Leaderboard switch in the main menu. Now you can switch through all leaderboards in terms of map, difficulty and team size.
 Major change in player ragdoll to make sure the player can't get stuck in walls, holes or elsewhere.
 Implemented a much more natural shooting behavior for both robots, with a delay when the player is first spotted for the first time or when not seen for a long time. So, Rocksy can not come around the corner and blow you up directly. Also better aim in the direction of the player. And prevent the bug that shooting robots can come to the player position without shooting at him.
 New Extreme difficulty. Unlock it by surviving 6 rounds on Hardcore. Up to 8 waves are awaiting you on Extreme!
 You can now change the shoulder side of the camera. Just hold down "Holster Weapon" (Q).
 Mutants are now called "MuTecs". This was a result of the TikTok poll and is meant to combine mutants and robots (technology) in one word.
 New effect for "speed boost" grenade
 Renaming of the difficulty levels.
 Now Hardcore difficulty (previously "Hard") is only available once you have completed Advanced (previously "Normal").
 New melee animations
 New speed boost grenade, higher player speed without negative effect on the bullet spread
 Player switch in the spectator camera, also possible to change back to your downed player
 Many small improvements and bugfixes!


What's in next weeks/months?

Close Combat Features
Normal enemy for waves greater 4
Third Boss
Third Map
Don't forget to vote your next most appreciated features in Discord in #📥vote-next-features


If you want to be a part of our closed beta testing community, visit us in discord. If you don't own the game already, you can simply grab a key in Discord 24/4 from key-bot. Discord: https://discord.gg/z2dXQXN

Stay tuned for next updates and keep giving us feedback, bug reports and your wishes and ideas. Thanks a lot!

Greetings,
Sebastian aka. TheFlow aka. GameDevDude

notes.title: Update: Close combat improved! Grenades improved! Bug fixes! And more!
notes.notes:
Hello dear Regain Earth Players, Testers, Community & Early Access Pioneers,

Over the past few weeks I've released a lot of minor updates to Regain Earth: First Strike, and here I'd like to give an overview of all those changes.

Thank you!
As always and first of all, I want to say a big thank you to our awesome testers & Discord community & TikTok community for giving me feedback on REFS and great new ideas. This is what drives the development of the game!
Thanks a lot!!!

[previewyoutube=6QMhrhlEna8;full][/previewyoutube]

Updates!
- Close Combat: you can now dissolve fences with a full charged melee hit! Please provide feedback on balancing. What do you think about the possibility of removing fences?
- Close Combat: melee no longer hurts teammate, hit energy recharges teammate's radar scan!
- Grenade throw indicates the arc the throw will make. Just hold down the throw button!
- Grenade balancing update: grenades explode faster, do more damage, health grenade has a longer effect
- Fixed annoying bug that mech won't stop shooting when you hide. Please let me know if it happens again! 
- Fixed bug that bullet shell can get stuck in the air.
- Performance: performance improvement when using the radar scan.
- Higher grenade drop rate
- Fixed that leader board is not showing correct ranks, when in single player played a different difficulty as when joining a multiplayer match right after
- Made AI footsteps a bit louder, perhaps a bit more next time, because it still seems a bit silent.
- New physical effect when hit barrels with close combat
- Bigger hit radius for close combat to hit more easily 3-4 foes when close
- Stronger explosive grenade
- Stronger frost grenade
- Less delay between throw grenade and grenade explode to make it more effective using grenades
- Mouse thumb keys 4 + 5 are now usable in REFS
- Improved effects on close combat
- Fixed bug on hanger to prevent player can get on top of white house
- Bug fixed on gamepad / controller, that the left thumb stick is inverted. Please check if everything works, also the invert options for the stick in the control menu still work. If the problem persists, please go to the input settings (button settings) and perform a "restore defaults" once.
- Fixed bug in close combat, that you could get into a state where the baton was still in your hand and so was the gun.



What's in next weeks?
Extreme Mode and Infinity/endless Mode
One more boss enemy and a normal enemy for waves greater 4
Third Map
Don't forget to vote your next most appreciated features in Discord in #📥vote-next-features


If you want to be a part of our closed beta testing community, visit us in discord. If you don't own the game already, you can simply grab a key in Discord 24/4 from key-bot. Discord: https://discord.gg/z2dXQXN

[previewyoutube=I3kaYve-Iks;full][/previewyoutube]

Updates!
New main features:

Gunplay: Implemented new Shooting Algorithm. Shot now is not coming from the camera center, but from the weapon muzzle. Also added a Laser Dot you can see when you use zoomed aiming and be close to a wall.
Spectator Mode when player character gets filled


New Enemy & Weapon types & AI updates:

Mech AI update. It's not perfect. Perfect AI is hard and need weeks, but I hope it's much better now. When the mech is behind the square container, it's very hard for him to hit you. This not about AI, it's simply because the MG of the mech is not able to hit you. Mech needs to fly or jump abilities later. But for now, the mech movement at the square container looks not so buggy anymore and the Mech is not running against the container all the time.
In Discord you can vote for more Mech AI Updates.


Gameplay & Feature Updates & Score Handling: 

Big improved and less network bandwidth needed solution to replicate Aiming pitch (player mate aim up down)
To better see if you hit a wall you are close to or not, a laser dot pointer for all "non-bolt, non shot-guns" weapons is implemented. Laser dot is not for aiming purpose, it's just to show you if shots go into the wall in front of you or not.


UI & Controls & Sounds:

Nothing new this time.


General Bugfixes & Performance improvements:

Fixed problem when having e.g a pole between camera and player, so shots do not hit the pole anymore.
Fixed that player can not shoot anymore when player get killed, by hold down shoot button after death
Fixed Crash on "Set current round to last round" Admin Cheat Menu
Fixed Admin Menu random Weapon drop was not working fine
Fixed Tooltips on mouse hover in Admin Cheat Menu
Minor bugfixes



What's next?
Work on Progression Loop and getting Achievements.
Divide Leaderboard to count of players in matched.
Start with first unlockable Items.
Plan out and start 2nd Map.
Many small improvements, bugfixes and additions
Everything what you need! Just tell me. Feedback is very welcome all the time. Come to Discord and vote what should be updated next!

Explosives
New Weapons
Fixed and working sound mixer


New Enemy & Weapon types & AI updates:

New Laser Rifle, with own visual effects
Also new Laser Pistol
Medium strength orange auto bolt weapon
Different AI hearing range per class
Changed that robot is not doing last shot when he is shot down. This was too confusing for some player.


Gameplay & Feature Updates & Score Handling: 

Added explosives. Gas cylinders can now explode and also implemented a generic way to add more explosives quickly and easily.
Player without weapon in hand now runs 25% faster as with weapon in hand
Added calculation to drop weapons and health a bit more "random controlled". To not have two weapon drops in a row and then have not drop anymore till rest of the game. Now the random drops are still random, but tried to influence random algorithm a bit.
Added verification, that the round only starts when all players are loaded into the multiplayer map. Also changed on round start that AI enemies first appear when all players are ready and the loading screen is gone for everyone.


UI & Controls & Sounds:

Sound mixer in sound menu is now fixed and fully working. Also for different channel.
Configured sounds to specific sound mixer categories like music, effects, dialog, etc.
Added functional mouse sensitivity settings and mouse invert settings under "general controls" menu
Deleted confusing "example sounds" from sound settings
Added new color scheme for buttons in menus and added small highlighting for important buttons like join, create, start game, etc.
Added real project version number to main menu
Fixed bug on self-kick admin from lobby-server without information for lobby clients
When player hold down fire button and zoom or do any action and after this action player still hold fire button, auto-fire is triggered again without need of press button again. E.g. Start Pressing fire button when reloading a auto fire weapon, starts shooting automatically when reload is finished.
When player hold down run button and zoom or do any action which prevents running and zoom/actions finished and still pressing run, that run is starting again automatically.


General Bugfixes:

Fixed Loading Screen flickering on Clients on starting Multiplayer Map
Fixed some bones for impulse animations
Improved Ragdoll on AI death on bullets and on explosions
Fixed bug on self-kick admin from lobby-server without information for lobby clients

Scanner to scan remaining enemies
Everything what players need. Just tell me.

Added new Enemy Scarecrow People, which have super powers to slow down Player. And they have a surprise for you! Fear them!
Added that players can be brought back from the dead at the end of the round. The player, however, is not directly alive. Instead all dead players will be revivable again on round start. This allows teammates to revive their dead teammates every time the round starts. Be careful and revive your dead teammates! Each death again triggers loose points for death.
Increased range to pick up weapons
AI tweaked a bit in general. For example robot AI is not waiting anymore when first time sees a player.
Implemented AI ability sytestem: Ai can now have different abilities / skills. Attack special abilities (super powers or similar), abilities when Ai first see the player, abilities when Ai hear the player shooting, etc. Scarecrows are the first enemy to use this, but more are to come.


Gameplay & Feature Updates & Score Handling: 

Tweaked scores a bit, also because new scarecrow enemy type.

Fix on bug prevents showing the right round number for clients on round 1

Fixed several smaller bugs

Explosions
New Enemies and new Weapon Models

New Enemy & Weapon types & AI updates:

Ai can shoot upwards to Player on Container or other higher platform
tweak some AI settings
Added a small amount of random spread of robots weapon, so robots do not shoot straight to player position anymore

Decreased size of red AI robot projectiles

Added evaluation of weapon value and only drop weapons with high value and high strength in later rounds (4 - 6)
Different enemies have different base score for get killed now. As example a robots kill gives more score to players as weak enemies.
Head shots get slightly more scores when make a kill, but really slightly
Added new calculation for end game score for multiplayer teams. Only the player with highest personal score gets the full team score. Other players get slightly less scores. This is also to prevent that in high score ranking players of a team get exactly the same score.
Added score deduction for friendly fire, do not harm your teammate! :-)
Added score bonus when player revived another player

Removed Ping on menus on which it was wrong and not needed

Fixed bug that on 6th round AI enemies are not attacking
Fixed bug to prevent needed game restart after a multiplayer match to start a new match
Fixed wrong player name in over head widget on revive for local player client
Fixed Chat in Lobby that Chat do not appear when Clients chat

New Enemies
